name: better-analyst-pdf-to-excel
description: Convert PDFs such as bank statements, invoices, and reports into clean Excel workbooks with Better Analyst AI Extract.

interface.longDescription: Attach a PDF and get back an Excel workbook. Better Analyst AI Extract pulls the rows and columns you ask for out of bank statements, invoices, receipts, and reports, and shows a preview right in the chat.
defaultPrompt: Convert this bank statement PDF to Excel with date, description, and amount columns.
Turn the invoice line items in this PDF into a spreadsheet.
